name: medical_pump_gap
claim_text: 1. An infusion pump comprising: a reservoir configured to store medication; a pump actuator configured to deliver the medication; and a biometric sensor configured to authenticate a patient before delivery.

prior_art_texts.title: Infusion pump
prior_art_texts.abstract: An infusion pump stores and delivers medication.
prior_art_texts.description: [0040] A reservoir stores medication. [0041] A pump actuator delivers the medication through tubing.
